races.rationale: Geological memory and the deepest inhabited caverns are ritually associated with the keeper of buried memory and the underworld.
Returned life, grave-bound vitality, preserved identity, and communal memory place the Djiumōtiakić closest to the administrator of death.
Treating decomposition as an archive of identity and memory connects Jaspey funerary ecology to Nefarokir.
Ferriers of souls and keepers of spirit passage are directly associated with death, spirits, memory, and the underworld.
The preservation and transfer of sensory memories gives Nefarokir a secondary place in remembrance rites.
Archived skins holding selected memories connect civic remembrance to Nefarokir.
The remembered past remains continuously present, giving memory rites a strong Nefarokir association.
